budget_items.what_was_recorded: P. Visconti said the Marshall Park bid went to Dillis and Roy and that he believed the amount was under $20,000.00, though unsure of the exact figure.
budget_items.quote: p. visconti stated he was unsure of the exact amount but believes it is under $20,000.00.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Beach House bid will go out again in January; the scope is $35,000, funded from the operation budget.
budget_items.quote: the scope of the bid is $35,000 which is funded from the operation budget.

budget_items.topic: Marshall Park pond and weed control estimate
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Solitude Lake Management gave a temporary cost estimate of $30,000.00 for the beach work.
budget_items.quote: temporary cost estimate received from solitude lake management were $30,000.00 for the beach.

budget_items.topic: Capital plan funding for pond work
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The pond work is on the Capital plan with $30,000 this year and money in 2025 for Marshall Pond.
budget_items.quote: this is a on the capital plan with $30,000 in this year, and money in 2025 for marshall pond.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A. Lockwood suggested a $40 fee per person for the proposed soccer program to cover operating costs.
budget_items.quote: a. lockwood suggested a $40 fee per person to cover operating costs.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The larger PARC grant was discussed for Marshall Park; K. Menard noted the smaller grant could be sought instead.
budget_items.quote: k. menard said if they didn't we could try for the smaller grant up to $100,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: P. Visconti and Katherine of WOLA were comfortable with $150-200,000 for the complete engineering phase; the Town Manager said $180,000 was available with about $10,000 left from the previous request.
budget_items.quote: a. lockwood stated p. visconti and katherine of wola feel comfortable with the amount of $150-200,000 for the complete engineering phase for marshall park.
